model.name: Salomon XT-Whisper - Women's
model.description:
Conquer the terrain with the Salomon XT-WHISPER. Rooted in the legendary XT lineage, these sneakers blend a provocatively textured upper with a modern wavy SensiFit design for a secure foothold. The play on matte and shiny finishes adds depth, while the Agile Chassis System provides the stability and dampening needed for every stride. Step into heritage performance with the Salomon XT-WHISPER.

  • 3D open mesh upper provides maximum breathability
  • SensiFit cradles the foot for a virtually customized fit
  • Quicklace system ensures a snug and impeccable hold
  • Anti-debris tongue offers an extra level of protection
  • Agile Chassis System works with the EnergyCell midsole for stability
  • Lugged rubber outsole delivers reliable traction

Material & Care
  • Textile and synthetic upper
  • Rubber outsole

Size & Fit
  • Low-top activewear silhouette
  • Flexible insole for comfortable movement
  • Arch support for all-day wearability
